card.fires_on: No shared word or setting. It fires on scattered pieces such as the US in USP, the D in Doses, a comma in a vaccine list, or WITH in an all-caps warning.
card.writes: The promoted tokens are all forms of 'debug', which has no link to these label contexts, so the output effect is unclear.
